Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert made a factual error by stating that a picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added on October 2, 2019. This claim was incorrect because the subsequent validation by the Validation_Expert, using the Wikipedia API, revealed that the image was actually added much later (on December 10, 2024). The error occurred at Step 3 when the WebServing_Expert provided this unverified and false date as the solution, contradicting the actual data retrieved from the source.
